description: Source code for a web-fetch tool that fetches URLs, extracts content, handles caching, error formatting, and content wrapping. Implements functions for configuration resolution, content processing, and tool creation.

methods.name: resolveFetchConfig
methods.description: Resolves web fetch configuration from the provided OpenClawConfig.

methods.name: resolveFetchEnabled
methods.description: Determines if fetch is enabled based on configuration and sandbox status.

methods.name: resolveFetchReadabilityEnabled
methods.description: Checks if readability enhancement is enabled in fetch config.

methods.name: resolveFetchMaxCharsCap
methods.description: Resolves maximum characters cap for fetch content.

methods.name: resolveFetchMaxResponseBytes
methods.description: Resolves maximum response bytes for fetch.

methods.name: resolveMaxChars
methods.description: Calculates the maximum number of characters to process, with fallback and cap.

methods.name: resolveMaxRedirects
methods.description: Determines maximum number of redirects allowed.

methods.name: looksLikeHtml
methods.description: Checks if a string appears to be HTML content.

methods.name: formatWebFetchErrorDetail
methods.description: Formats detailed error message, converting HTML to markdown/text if needed.

methods.name: redactUrlForDebugLog
methods.description: Redacts URL for debug logging, showing only origin or path.

methods.name: wrapWebFetchContent
methods.description: Wraps content with overhead considerations, truncates if necessary.

methods.name: wrapWebFetchField
methods.description: Wraps a string field for external content display.

methods.name: normalizeContentType
methods.description: Normalizes content type string, removing parameters.

methods.name: isRecord
methods.description: Type guard to check if a value is a record object.

methods.name: normalizeProviderFinalUrl
methods.description: Validates and normalizes provider final URL.

methods.name: normalizeProviderWebFetchPayload
methods.description: Normalizes payload from web fetch provider, wrapping text and setting metadata.

methods.name: maybeFetchProviderWebFetchPayload
methods.description: Attempts to fetch payload from provider fallback if available.

methods.name: runWebFetch
methods.description: Main function to perform web fetch, handle caching, content extraction, and error handling.

methods.name: createWebFetchTool
methods.description: Creates a web fetch tool with configuration, including content extraction and caching.
